_about: Famous college late-game situations (2016-2026) that the play-by-play has, with good clocks. Each is found in the data by its game, quarter, clock (quarter seconds left at the snap, +- tol) and team: never by row number, which a data revision can move. Every fact in a story was checked against the play-by-play (scores, clock, plays, kick distances); the start state comes from the data. Missing from the release (not buildable from data): the 2016 and 2017 national title games, the 2018 SEC title game and the 2022 Peach Bowl.

drills.title: Clemson, up 2: 4th & 1 at the Pitt 35, 1:02 left
drills.story: 2016: Clemson led Pitt 42-40 and went for it on 4th and 1 at the Pitt 35 with 1:02 left. Stopped, it gave Pitt the ball, and Chris Blewitt's 48-yard field goal with six seconds left won it 43-42.

drills.title: Pitt, down 2: own 36, 0:58 left
drills.story: 2016: Pitt took over at its 36, down 42-40 at Clemson with 0:58 left and one timeout, and drove to the Clemson 30. Chris Blewitt's 48-yard field goal with six seconds left won it 43-42.

drills.title: Louisville, down 6: 4th & 12 at the Clemson 14, 0:38 left
drills.story: 2016: Louisville trailed Clemson 42-36 on 4th and 7 at the Clemson 9; a false start made it 4th and 12. Lamar Jackson's pass to James Quick gained 11, a yard short, and Clemson won 42-36.

drills.title: Texas A&M, down 2 after a touchdown, 0:46 left
drills.story: 2018: Kellen Mond's touchdown pass pulled Texas A&M within 28-26 of Clemson in the final minute. The Aggies went for two, it failed, and Clemson won 28-26.

drills.title: Alabama, down 5 after a touchdown: kick off with 1:21 left
drills.story: 2019: DeVonta Smith's 85-yard touchdown catch cut LSU's lead to 46-41 with 1:21 left. Alabama kicked onside, LSU recovered at the Alabama 49 and knelt out the clock: 46-41.

drills.title: Alabama, down 3: 4th & 11 at the Auburn 13, 2:04 left
drills.story: 2019: down 48-45 at Auburn, Alabama kicked on 4th and 11 from the 13 with 2:04 left. Joseph Bulovas missed from 30 yards; an Alabama substitution infraction on Auburn's 4th and 4 gave Auburn a first down, and it knelt out the clock: 48-45.

drills.title: Alabama, down 7: own 3, 1:35 left, no timeouts
drills.story: 2021: Alabama trailed Auburn 10-3 at its own 3 with 1:35 left and no timeouts. Bryce Young drove 97 yards, spiking once, and hit Ja'Corey Brooks for a 28-yard touchdown to tie it 10-10; Alabama won 24-22 in four overtimes.

drills.title: Tennessee, tied 49-49: own 32, 0:15 left, two timeouts
drills.story: 2022: Will Reichard's 50-yard field goal for Alabama missed with 0:15 left, tied 49-49. Hendon Hooker hit Ramel Keyton for 18 and Bru McCoy for 27, and Chase McGrath's 40-yard field goal won it 52-49 as time ran out.

drills.title: Oregon, up 4: 4th & 3 at the Washington 47, 2:16 left
drills.story: 2023: Oregon led Washington 33-29 and went for it on 4th and 3 at the Washington 47 with 2:16 left; Bo Nix's pass fell incomplete. Michael Penix Jr. found Ja'Lynn Polk for 35 and Rome Odunze for an 18-yard touchdown, and Camden Lewis' 43-yard try at the end missed: Washington 36-33.

drills.title: Oregon, down 3: own 25, 1:38 left
drills.story: 2023: down 36-33 after Washington's touchdown, Oregon started at its 25 with 1:38 left and reached the Washington 25. Camden Lewis' 43-yard field goal missed at the end: Washington 36-33.

drills.title: Oregon, down 3 after a touchdown: kick off with 2:14 left, three timeouts
drills.story: 2023 Pac-12 Championship: Bo Nix's 63-yard touchdown pass to Traeshon Holden pulled Oregon within 34-31 of Washington. Oregon kicked onside with 2:14 left and all three timeouts; Washington recovered at its 45 and ran out the clock: 34-31.

drills.title: Alabama, tied 20-20: own 25, 1:34 left, three timeouts
drills.story: Rose Bowl, Jan. 1, 2024 (CFP semifinal): J.J. McCarthy's 4-yard touchdown to Roman Wilson tied Michigan and Alabama 20-20 with 1:38 left. Alabama, at its 25 with three timeouts, ran five plays and punted from its 43 with 0:54 left; Michigan won 27-20 in overtime.

drills.title: Ohio State, down 1: 3rd & 20 at the Oregon 38, 0:06 left, no timeouts
drills.story: 2024: Ohio State trailed Oregon 32-31 with 0:06 left, 3rd and 20 at the Oregon 38 after an Oregon illegal-substitution flag, and no timeouts. Will Howard ran 12 yards to the 26 and time ran out before a field-goal try: Oregon 32-31.

drills.title: Alabama, up 5 after a touchdown, 2:29 left
drills.story: 2024: Ryan Williams' 75-yard touchdown catch put Alabama ahead of Georgia 39-34. It went for two and Jalen Milroe hit Germie Bernard: 41-34. Georgia drove to the Alabama 20 before Carson Beck was intercepted in the end zone: Alabama 41-34.

drills.title: Alabama, up 7 on defense: Georgia at its 25, 2:18 left
drills.story: 2024: up 41-34 after Ryan Williams' 75-yard touchdown and a two-point try, Alabama kicked off with 2:18 left. Georgia drove to the Alabama 20, and Carson Beck's next pass was intercepted for a touchback: Alabama 41-34.
